summary: Refrigeration controls at supermarkets and blood-storage sites have been attacked. Internet-exposed controllers remain a concern.
reason: The latest reviewed major wave occurred on 2 November. EFS has confirmed a contained incident at three sites on that date. France’s November 9 attribution to Iran concerns the October 11–12 campaign; responsibility for the November incidents and a common perpetrator remain unconfirmed. No verified later major wave was found in this review.
